subject.title: Feature: Add costCurrency config option to customize cost display currency

question: Should OpenClaw keep configured model costs USD-only, or define a non-USD currency contract for local model-pricing estimates?
rationale: The request adds public config and changes semantics across config schema, status output, Control UI cost analysis, diagnostics, docs, and mixed-provider aggregation.

options.title: Design the currency contract first
options.body: Choose provider/model/global scope, ISO validation, mixed-currency behavior, persisted-field semantics, and docs before implementation.

options.title: Keep local estimates USD-only
options.body: Leave `models.providers.*.models[].cost` as USD per million tokens and keep non-USD facts only in provider-reported billing surfaces.

options.title: Allow display-only override
options.body: Permit a narrow symbol/currency override while documenting that stored totals and APIs remain USD-shaped estimates.

recommendation.title: Design the currency contract first
recommendation.body: Choose provider/model/global scope, ISO validation, mixed-currency behavior, persisted-field semantics, and docs before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the recent usage and provider-billing work most likely to define the durable product contract.
